segments.sn35.204:1.4: Yadanattā, taṃ ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ … pe … jivhā aniccā atītā.
segments.sn35.204:1.8: Yadanattā, taṃ ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ … pe … mano anicco atīto.
segments.sn35.204:1.12: Yadanattā, taṃ ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ.
segments.sn35.204:1.13: Evaṃ passaṃ … pe … nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānātī”ti.
